comment: Traduccion ES de High Seas Havoc (USA). Fuente de verdad unica.

0.original: EMERALDA...A LEGENDARY GEM WITH       [LF]  MAGICAL POWERS, STRONG ENOUGH TO      [LF]  CONQUER ARMIES AND TOPPLE KINGDOMS.   [LF]                                        [END]
0.translated: ESMERALDA... UNA GEMA LEGENDARIA CON  [LF]  PODERES MÁGICOS, LO BASTANTE FUERTES  [LF]  COMO PARA CONQUISTAR EJÉRCITOS Y      [LF]  DERROCAR REINOS.                      [END]

1.original: IT WAS THE EVIL PIRATE SCOUNDREL      [LF]  BERNARDO WHO FIRST RECOGNIZED         [LF]  EMERALDA'S MAGIC.                     [LF]                                        [END]
1.translated: FUE EL MALVADO PIRATA BERNARDO QUIEN  [LF]  RECONOCIÓ PRIMERO LA MAGIA DE LA      [LF]  ESMERALDA.                            [LF]                                        [END]

2.original: AND HE SET OUT TO FIND THE SECRET     [LF]  MAP THAT LED TO EMERALDA'S            [LF]  WHEREABOUTS.                          [LF]                                        [END]
2.translated: Y PARTIÓ EN BUSCA DEL MAPA SECRETO  [LF]  QUE LLEVABA AL PARADERO DE LA         [LF]  ESMERALDA.                            [LF]                                        [END]

3.original: MEANWHILE, OUR HERO HAVOC WAS         [LF]  LIVING IN PEACE AND ROAMING THE SEAS  [LF]  WITH HIS SIDEKICK, TIDE, UNAWARE OF   [LF]  BERNARDO'S EVIL SCHEME.               [END]
3.translated: MIENTRAS TANTO, NUESTRO HÉROE HAVOC   [LF]  VIVÍA EN PAZ Y RECORRÍA LOS MARES     [LF]  CON SU COMPAÑERO TIDE, SIN SABER EL   [LF]  PLAN MALVADO DE BERNARDO.             [END]

4.original: ONE DAY, THE TWO CAME ACROSS A YOUNG  [LF]  MAIDEN WASHED UP ON THE SHORE...      [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
4.translated: UN DÍA, LOS DOS ENCONTRARON A UNA     [LF]  JOVEN DONCELLA EN LA ORILLA...        [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

6.original: AFTER A WHILE, THE GIRL OPENED HER    [LF]  EYES.                                 [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
6.translated: DESPUÉS DE UN RATO, LA CHICA ABRIÓ    [LF]  LOS OJOS.                             [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

7.original: "UH...OOH...MY NAME IS BRIDGET."      [LF]  "THIS MAP IS VERY IMPORTANT."         [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
7.translated: "EH... AH... ME LLAMO BRIDGET."       [LF]  "ESTE MAPA ES MUY IMPORTANTE."        [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

8.original: "YOU MUST PROTECT IT AND KEEP IT      [LF]  FROM BERNARDO. PLEASE HELP ME."       [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
8.translated: "DEBES PROTEGERLO Y EVITAR QUE        [LF]  BERNARDO SE LO QUEDE. ¡AYÚDAME!"      [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

9.original: "DON'T WORRY. YOU CAN COUNT ON US,    [LF]  MA'AM!"                               [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
9.translated: "NO SE PREOCUPE. PUEDE CONTAR CON     [LF]  NOSOTROS, ¡SEÑORITA!"                 [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

10.original: THE TWO TOOK THE MAP AND HID IT IN A  [LF]  CAVE HIGH IN THE CLIFFS.              [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
10.translated: LOS DOS COGIERON EL MAPA Y LO         [LF]  ESCONDIERON EN LO ALTO DE LOS         [LF]  ACANTILADOS.                          [LF]                                        [END]

11.original: AS THE DAYS WENT BY, BRIDGET          [LF]  SLOWLY RECOVERED, AND THE THREE       [LF]  BECAME FAST FRIENDS.                  [LF]                                        [END]
11.translated: CON EL PASO DE LOS DÍAS, BRIDGET SE   [LF]  RECUPERÓ POCO A POCO, Y LOS TRES SE   [LF]  VOLVIERON BUENOS AMIGOS.              [LF]                                        [END]

12.original: ...THAT IS, UNTIL ONE OF BERNARDO'S   [LF]  HENCHMEN DISCOVERED THEM.             [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
12.translated: ...HASTA QUE UNO DE LOS ESBIRROS DE   [LF]  BERNARDO LOS DESCUBRIÓ.               [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]

13.original: UNDER THE COVER OF NIGHT, HE          [LF]  KIDNAPPED BRIDGET AND TIDE, AND       [LF]  TOOK THEM AWAY TO BERNARDO'S          [LF]  HIDEAWAY.                             [END]
13.translated: AL AMPARO DE LA NOCHE, SECUESTRÓ A    [LF]  BRIDGET Y A TIDE, Y SE LOS LLEVÓ A    [LF]  LA GUARIDA DE BERNARDO.               [LF]                                        [END]

14.original: IT'S UP TO HAVOC TO SAVE THEM.        [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [LF]                                        [END]
